correctness.rationale: Substituting the source’s first-dose-only assumptions into its printed dimensional reproduction number gives an exact two-control formula. Algebraic factorization makes K epsilon a sharp infimum, and the if-and-only-if crossing criterion follows directly. Exact rational evaluation of the printed parameters gives K epsilon approximately 1.4022042175 and the scalar formal root approximately 1.0215898907.

originality.rationale: Imperfect-vaccine thresholds are established epidemiological mathematics, so no general methodological priority is claimed. The original content is the source-specific sharp infimum over both first-dose channels, the exact feasibility criterion K epsilon < 1, and the consequence that the paper’s entire first-dose-only strategy class is unable to cross the unit threshold at its fitted parameters.
residual_risks: A non-indexed correction or commentary could have noted the same algebraic obstruction.
The theorem is specific to the no-second-dose, no-treatment intervention slice and does not imply that combined interventions cannot achieve a subunit reproduction number.
The conclusion is about the model’s reproduction-number threshold rather than a direct clinical effectiveness claim.

value.rationale: Section 3.6 explicitly interprets first-dose vaccination as an eradication mechanism and gives a critical value above 100 percent. The sharp two-control calculation shows that this is not merely a domain typo: imperfect vaccination creates a structural reproduction-number floor above one, so even unbounded adult first-dose delivery cannot make the first-dose-only strategy subcritical. This materially changes the interpretation of the paper’s first-dose sensitivity experiment.
